Parametric generators for 3DCraft: open one, set its parameters, export the result. No AI needed.

GT2 pulley (2 mm pitch)

A timing pulley for GT2 belts with 2 mm pitch: set the teeth, the belt width and the bore, with or without flanges and a hub. Pitch diameter = teeth x 2 mm / pi; the outside diameter is 0.508 mm less. Belt fit widens the grooves for 3D printing. Export it with File > Export... (STL or 3MF to print, STEP for CAD). Tooth outline from droftarts' Parametric Pulley (thingiverse.com/thing:16627), CC BY-SA 4.0; this Jig is shared under the same licence.

Parameters: Teeth, Belt width, Belt fit, Bore, Hub, Hub diameter, Hub length, Flanges

Key tags

A sheet of key tags or name-tag blanks to laser-cut (or 3D-print): a rounded rectangle, a circle or a hexagon with a key-ring hole, as many columns and rows as you like (one per student), kerf included. To cut it: File > Export..., choose SVG or DXF and the face set "Cut sheet" (file.export {"path": "tags.svg", "set": "Cut sheet"}); engrave names on the tags in your laser software.

Parameters: Shape, Width, Height, Corner radius, Ring hole, Hole margin, Sheet thickness, Columns, Rows, Kerf

Laser-cut box

A finger-jointed box with a loose lid, for laser cutting from sheet. Set the outside size, the sheet thickness, the finger width and your laser's kerf. To cut it: File > Export..., choose DXF or SVG and the face set "Cut sheet" (file.export {"path": "box.svg", "set": "Cut sheet"}): all six panels on one sheet at true size, kerf included.

Parameters: Width, Depth, Height, Sheet thickness, Finger width, Kerf, Clearance, Thumb notch radius, Lid hole radius

Phone and tablet stand

A stand that holds a phone or tablet at the angle you choose: set the device's thickness (with its case), the angle, the length of the back rest and the lip, the width, and whether a charging cable passes through the front. Print it lying on its side (the profile on the bed) for strength, without supports. Export it with File > Export... (STL or 3MF).

Parameters: Angle, Device thickness, Back rest length, Lip height, Width, Wall thickness, Cable slot, Cable slot width

Potentiometer knob

A grippy knob for a potentiometer, rotary encoder or switch: choose the shaft (6 mm or 1/4 in, D-shaft or round), tune the fit, set the size, the grip spacing (the number of grooves follows the circumference), a skirt and a pointer. Print it upside down (top on the bed) or standing with the skirt down. Export it with File > Export... (STL or 3MF).

Parameters: Shaft, Fit, Hole depth, Diameter, Height, Grip spacing, Skirt, Pointer

Involute spur gear

A spur gear with true involute teeth, drawn from the involute's formula: choose the module and the pressure angle, set the number of teeth, the face width and the bore, with or without a hub. Pitch diameter = module x teeth, outside diameter = module x (teeth + 2); two gears mesh when they share module and pressure angle, at a centre distance of module x (teeth1 + teeth2) / 2. Export it with File > Export... (STL or 3MF to print, STEP for CAD).

Parameters: Module, Teeth, Pressure angle, Face width, Bore, Hub, Hub diameter, Hub length

Wavy vase

A vase or plant-pot cover whose wall waves and twists, drawn from a formula: r = R (1 + depth x cos(waves x t)), each height turned a little further. Set the diameters, the height and the belly, the number and depth of the waves and the twist. The model is solid: print it in your slicer's vase mode (spiralize outer contour) for a thin, watertight wall with a closed bottom. Export it with File > Export... (STL or 3MF).

Parameters: Bottom diameter, Top diameter, Height, Belly, Waves, Wave depth, Twist

Welding table

A fixture welding table to cut from 1/4 in steel plate: a top plate with a 2 in grid of 16 mm holes on a grid of half-lapped ribs, joined by tabs in slots shaped for plug welds. Set the plate size (capped at 48 x 36 in so it stays quick, also in the browser), your cutter's kerf and the slot clearance. To cut it: File > Export..., choose DXF or SVG and the face set "Cut sheet" (file.export {"path": "table.dxf", "set": "Cut sheet"}): the plate and every rib on one sheet at true size, kerf included.

Parameters: Length, Width, Kerf, Clearance, Tabs per cell
